summary: World Omni Auto Receivables LLC filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for the sole purpose of attaching Exhibit 107 (filing fees table) that was inadvertently omitted from the final prospectus for the $1,236,870,000 asset-backed notes offering by World Omni Auto Receivables Trust 2026-A. This is a routine correction filing; it does not announce a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. The filing simply corrects an administrative omission.
